journey.name: EXC-06: 数据为空与空状态展示场景
journey.description: 验证在无历史会话、无附件暂存、无审计日志等零数据场景下，应用各界面均如实展示符合规范的空状态组件（带清晰引导提示），不渲染假数据，不出现布局崩溃或死循环。

actions.action: Verify that the message timeline shows the ready or empty conversation state
Click the navigation menu icon "打开会话抽屉" in top bar
Verify that when conversation history is empty the drawer provides a clear "新建对话" prompt
Click the "设置" action icon in top bar
Swipe down to the audit log section
Verify that empty audit log displays an honest zero-event empty state without mock data
Click the "返回" icon to return to workbench
